csv_scope_of_work: The City of Greenville, NC, desires to obtain Civil Engineering, Architecture, and Landscape Architecture services for various City departments. The City desires to supplement its existing professional staff to accomplish its mission of developing and executing various types of Capital Improvement Projects and Facility Improvement Projects. Typical types of work could include, but are not limited to, the following: Design services for emergency repairs for city infrastructure; Design services for work related to new or existing buildings, parks, or other facilities; Design services for project related site plans; Design services for repair of storm water drainage systems; Design services for projects to construct streets, sidewalks, and bike lanes;

title: On-Call 2026 Architectural & Engineering Services IQC
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary design services for Greenville capital and facility improvement projects.
project_scope: Indefinite quantity contract for various city capital improvement and facility improvement projects across Greenville. Typical assignments may include emergency repair design for city infrastructure, design for new or existing buildings, parks and other facilities, site plan design, stormwater drainage repair design, and projects for streets, sidewalks, and bike lanes. No specific structure, span, floor area, or single project scope is defined.
services: On-call civil engineering, architectural, and landscape architectural services for multiple city departments; design services for infrastructure and facility projects; site plans; stormwater drainage repairs; streets, sidewalks, and bike lanes.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call contract for broad multidisciplinary services without a defined technically demanding structure.
- Includes many low-relevance scopes for sbp such as general buildings, parks, site plans, landscape architecture, and municipal infrastructure.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or complex structural engineering component is identified.
- Contract appears focused on general municipal A/E support rather than specialized structural design.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value 1.0M; interpreted as total contract value rather than construction cost.
fee_explanation: No explicit sbp-relevant design fee is stated. The document only gives a total contract value of 1.0M for the on-call services contract.
